text.description_html:
CFK70-7015-B571, Restroom Door Push and Pull Set with Occupancy Indicator Lock

This Restroom Handle Set with Occupancy Indicator comes packaged with a 3-1/2 inch x 15 inch push plate, a pull plate with a 6-3/4 inch handle, and a commercial grade privacy door bolt with occupancy indicator. Both the exterior and the interior plates are made from stainless steel and the door bolt trim is made from solid brass. It is adjustable to accommodate door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches with a 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets. The Restroom Door Push and Pull Set with Occupancy Indicator Lock is easy to install and comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware. It is great for use on commercial and office bathroom doors. The bolt thrown or retracted by inside thumb turn unit. Occupancy indicator on outside reads either "In Use" or "Vacant".

Also available: Door Push and Pull Plate Set with Single Cylinder Deadbolt

Package Includes:

  • (1) Restroom Door Occupancy Indicator Lock
  • (1) 3-1/2" x 15" Stainless Steel Push Plate
  • (1) 3-1/2" x 15" Stainless Steel Pull Plate
  • (1) 6 inch c.c. Stainless Steel Pull
  • All mounting hardware

Features of the Entrance Set with Push Plate, Pull Plate, and Privacy Door Bolt with Occupancy Indicator:

  • Door lock is ADA compliant.
  • Door lock is ANSI Grade 2.
  • Includes Safety Release Key for opening locked doors in emergency cases.

Specifications of CFK70-7015-B571 Stainless Steel Pull Plate with Restroom Door Occupancy Indicator Lock:

  • Interior and Exterior Plate Material: Stainless Steel
  • Occupancy Door Bolt Trim Material: Solid Brass
  • Interior and Exterior Plate Height: 15"
  • Interior and Exterior Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Interior and Exterior Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Exterior Pull Handle Diameter: 3/4"
  • Exterior Pull Handle Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Exterior Pull Handle Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Exterior Pull Handle Center to Center (CTC): 6"
  • Total Exterior Pull Length: 6-3/4"
  • Exterior Pull Handle is 4-1/2" from top and bottom of plate.
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8 to 1-3/4" thick doors.
  • Finish: Brushed Silver
  • Push and Pull Plate Set Dimensions (PDF)

The privacy door bolt uses a thumbturn inside and has occupancy indicator outside.
